# MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1 Lubrication and fluids - Machining CNC turning center #3

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-CN03

Scope
- This procedure defines the way lubrication refill and lubricant identification for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03). It applies to in-plant maintenance personnel performing routine lubrication and verification during production support and scheduled maintenance.

Tools
- Clean lint-free cloths
- Oil drain pan suitable for contaminant control
- Oil cartridge funnel or approved dispensing nozzle
- Personal protective equipment as required by site SOPs

Lubricants
- The way lube refill interval for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 60 hours.  
- The lubricant part number for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is CFW-LUB-662.

Procedure
- Verify machine is in a safe state for maintenance per SOP-P1-L3-02 and lockout/tagout requirements. Consult SB-1014 for machine-specific service access points.
- Clean the way filler area to remove chips and coolant residue. Use lint-free cloths to ensure filler port and surrounding surfaces are dry and free of debris.
- Remove filler cap and inspect filler aperture and visible way surfaces for contamination or signs of wear. If contamination or abnormal wear is observed, stop and escalate per SOP-P1-L3-04.
- Refill way lubricant using lubricant part number CFW-LUB-662 until sight level indicates correct service level. Replace filler cap and wipe external surfaces.
- Record service action in maintenance log, noting equipment EQ-P1-L3-CN03, lubricant used, and reference to SB-1014 and SOP-P1-L3-02.

Acceptance criteria
- No external leakage from filler cap or seals after refill.
- Way surfaces free of visible contamination at the filler aperture.
- Maintenance log entry complete with lubricant part number CFW-LUB-662 and reference to related documents.

Related documents
- SB-1014
- SOP-P1-L3-02
- SOP-P1-L3-04
